simple.meaning: שְׁנַיִם (shᵉnayim) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “two ; also (as ordinal) twofold.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 769 times across Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 1:16. Its contexts include family, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁנַיִם (H8147).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שְׁנַיִם (shᵉnayim) / H8147 is traced through Genesis 1:16, Genesis 2:25, Genesis 3:7, Genesis 4:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.
